style.backgroundSystem: only three fields are allowed across the set: a real warm bedroom (matte oat plaster wall #EAE0CE over brushed oak floor #C9A97F, bed made up in warm cream linen #F5EFE4 with a visible mattress edge), seamless flat colour-block graphic fields in warm paper #FBF7EF, pale butter #F2E3A8 and oat sage #C6CDB4 closed by one large rounded-corner off-white card that overlaps the colour block, and one full caramel brown panel #B4763C with pale butter pips for trust and process screens; 24px corner radius on every card, one clean copy zone per screen, never busy decor
style.direction: warm colour-block bedding commerce, sunlit bedroom editorial built from flat caramel, butter and oat panels rather than airy nordic daylight or slate graphic interiors
style.iconSystem: solid circular pips filled #F2E3A8 with a 1.5px pictogram knocked out of them, plus rounded capsule pill labels on a #B4763C fill carrying #FBF7EF text, and a small plus mark or three-dot mark as the only ornaments; maximum six labelled elements per screen, 1px hairline leader lines in #4A3A2C, four-card grid allowed for evidence screens; no square number chips, no oversized bare numerals, no 3D badges, no gradient seals, no photo-inset certificates
style.lightingSystem: warm low morning sunlight at 3500-3800K entering from a declared off-frame window at camera right, raking long soft shadows across the quilt surface, gentle warm bounce fill off the oat wall, one believable contact shadow wherever bedding meets mattress or floor, no hard speculars and no hotspots; only the closing night screen may switch to a single 2700K bedside practical while every other screen keeps the same morning source and the same shadow direction; this is deliberately NOT a cool 6500K north-daylight wash and NOT a flat neutral 4200K mixed-interior grade
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm colour-block bedding visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of caramel brown #B4763C, pale butter #F2E3A8, oat sage #C6CDB4, warm paper #FBF7EF, deep coffee text #4A3A2C and one amber accent #E2A03F, with the quilt shell kept exactly as supplied in warm cream #F0E6D6; warm grade throughout, never a cool 6500K north-daylight wash and never a neutral 4200K slate graphic grade; one rounded-terminal soft Chinese sans-serif family with headlines in #4A3A2C or knocked out in #FBF7EF on caramel, one oversized English display word in #B4763C as a graphic element and all Chinese copy wrapped in 「」 and kept short; backgrounds limited to a real warm bedroom with a matte oat plaster wall #EAE0CE over brushed oak floor #C9A97F with the bed made up in warm cream linen #F5EFE4, seamless flat colour-block fields in warm paper #FBF7EF, pale butter #F2E3A8 and oat sage #C6CDB4 closed by one rounded-corner off-white card, and one full caramel panel #B4763C with butter pips for trust and process screens, each screen holding one clean copy zone; lighting always warm low morning sun at 3500-3800K from a declared off-frame window at camera right raking long soft shadows across the quilt with a gentle warm bounce fill and one believable contact shadow where bedding meets mattress, only the closing night screen switching to a single 2700K bedside practical, no hard speculars; surface system of matte brushed textile shell with real fibre slubs exactly as supplied, matte plaster, brushed oak with one visible grain direction and matte stoneware, never gloss, never satin, never plastic; layout system of vertical colour bands split one third to two thirds, 24px rounded corners, solid circular pips in #F2E3A8 with a knocked-out 1.5px pictogram, rounded capsule pill labels on #B4763C with #FBF7EF text, 1px hairline leader lines, one plus or three-dot mark and at most six labelled elements per screen; product presentation rules: identical size relationship to the bed, identical stitch or baffle-channel layout, edge binding, corner loops and warm cream shell tone in every frame, always grounded on a real mattress or floor with a believable contact shadow, corrected straight verticals, a real furnishing as human scale anchor, the slight 3/4 mattress-height angle reused across scene screens, at most one anonymous cropped figure; no color palette changes, no recoloured or re-patterned shell, no invented quilting or trim, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched pill and pip styles, no invented dimensions, wool percentages, fill weights, warmth ratings, clean-cycle counts, shrinkage figures, origin claims, eco grades or certificates, no brand marks, no QR codes, no membership or free-gift badges, no prices, no visible faces.
noDrift: no recoloured, re-patterned or re-graded quilt shell, no satin or glossy fabric
no invented quilting, piping, buttons, corner loops, trim or second colour the product does not have
no mixed fonts and no decorative script lettering
no inconsistent lighting direction, no contradictory shadow lengths, no cool 6500K daylight grade and no neutral slate graphic grade
no mismatched pill, pip or card styles and no square number chips

style.presentationRules: the quilt keeps one size relationship to the bed, the same stitch or baffle-channel layout, the same edge binding, the same corner loops and the same warm cream shell tone in every frame; it always lies on a real mattress or rests folded on a real floor with a believable contact shadow and never floats; a real furnishing (bed frame, nightstand, folded throw, mattress stack) always anchors human scale; interior verticals, window frames, floor lines and card edges stay straight and corrected; the slight 3/4 mattress-height angle of the opening screen is reused on the closing screen so the set reads as one room; at most one screen may carry a person and that person must be anonymous and cropped with no visible face
style.surfaceSystem: the quilt shell stays a matte brushed textile in warm cream #F0E6D6 with real fibre slubs exactly as supplied, matte plaster wall, brushed oak floor #C9A97F with one visible grain direction, matte stoneware and unglazed ceramic, matte paper graphic fields; never gloss, never satin sheen, never plastic or vinyl, no wet-look highlights on the filling
style.typography: one rounded-terminal soft Chinese sans-serif family only, headlines set in deep coffee #4A3A2C on light fields and knocked out in warm paper #FBF7EF on caramel fields, the same family at light weight for labels and numerals, plus one oversized single English display word (for example COMFORT) set large in #B4763C as a graphic element overlapping a card edge; small letter-spaced uppercase English captions under table titles only; no serif, handwritten, retro or cartoon face; Chinese in-image copy always wrapped in 「」 and kept short, headline 28-34pt, pill label 12-14pt, sub-label 11-12pt, per-screen text budget under 50 characters
